title: Utvikling og utdanning av barnehagelæreres pedagogiske ledelse
summary: This book explores pedagogical leadership in early childhood education as a professional, relational, and organisational practice shaped by historical, political, and structural developments. The chapters offer diverse perspectives on leadership, spanning policy developments, professional roles, organisational structures, professional judgement, collaboration, and collective learning. The book also examines leadership development in teacher education, supervision practices, competence-building strategies, and new leadership roles emerging within the sector. Bringing together empirical studies and theoretical contributions, the anthology provides an updated multifaceted understanding of pedagogical leadership as it is enacted within a changing ECEC context. It invites readers to reflect on how pedagogical leadership is interpreted, negotiated, and developed amid increasing expectations, new organisational arrangements, and a growing emphasis on quality and professionalisation.
